# Test files that exist but run in no workflow, each with a reason and a date
# by which someone decides to wire it, fix it or delete it.
#
#   path/to/test_x.py | YYYY-MM-DD | one-line reason
#
# scripts/ci/check_test_wiring.py reads this file on every PR (ci-lint). An
# entry past its date is reported as a warning; an entry for a file that does
# not exist, or that a workflow now runs, fails the check.
#
# Empty on 2026-10-08: every test file that existed then is wired.
